objective: Bring the Spy's Report to a Theramore Lieutenant.

description: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found.  And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube.  And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
The parchment is written in orcish... and it looks important.
progress: Do you have a report to make?
completion: Hm... I can't read orcish very well, but this looks like a report... written by an orc spy!
